original.statement: The storage version of secretstores.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1; existing v1beta1 objects remain stored in v1beta1 until rewritten via storage version migration.

corrected.statement: external-secrets.io/v1beta1 SecretStore stops being the storage version of the secretstores.external-secrets.io CRD (spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage: true → false, 0.15.0 → 0.16.0); v1 becomes the storage version and existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten.

decision.reason: [ev-f07fad593227] shows the secretstores.external-secrets.io CRD's spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage going from true to false between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0. The restatement validator confirms this computed change names the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 SecretStore gvk, so the subject is right. behavior-changed is the right change type: v1beta1 is still served but is no longer the storage version, and it is not deprecated (validator refuted P3's 'deprecated'). The before/after values 'storage version'/'non-storage version' paraphrase the evidence, so I replaced them with the values the artifact states, true → false.
